subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice lane & dynamic net-cycle proposal
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@orchidcloud.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel@orchidcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: payment terms & invoice lane request

Hi Markus / Marissa,

Thanks for starting the onboarding process — glad to be moving forward. Attached are our completed vendor onboarding form and W-9. Before you create the PO, a quick note on payment terms that matter on our side:

- Standard contract expectation: Net 60 (monthly billing cycle).
- For the initial pilot (first 3 months) we can offer a 1.5% discount for Net 30 payment.
- We are open to a transition plan if Redwood requires different cadence.

We'd like to request an "accelerated invoice lane" for the pilot invoices so we can receive payments within 30 days; after the pilot we can revert to Net 60 unless otherwise agreed. Can you confirm the PO creation timeline and any additional vendor forms you need?

Attachments: orchid_vendor_onboard_form.pdf (fillable), orchid_w9.pdf

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Revenue Operations | Orchid Cloud
elena@orchidcloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@orchidcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment terms & invoice lane request

Elena — thanks for the forms and clarity. Quick internal note and proposal so everyone is aligned: 

- Redwood standard vendor onboarding: Net 60.
- For pilot customers we can support an accelerated lane but prefer a middle ground: Net 45 with an early-pay discount to balance cashflow.
- Proposed pilot concession: Net 45 + 1% early-pay if paid within 15 days of invoice. First 90 days can be treated as the "pilot" window.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa/Neha to confirm whether finance can create a special AP route for "Vendor-Accelerated" invoices.
2) If accepted, we create PO template referencing this payment lane and the early-pay clause.
3) Elena to confirm acceptance or counter-offer (discount %, pilot length).

Marissa/Neha — can you weigh in on PO timing and whether AP needs any additional fields on the onboarding form (bank routing, remit email)?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Elena Rossi <elena@orchidcloud.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel@orchidcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment terms & invoice lane request

Thanks Markus — appreciated. We can accept the middle ground with one adjustment during onboarding:

- Accept Net 45 for pilot with a 2.0% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days for the first 90 days only.
- After the 90-day pilot, revert to Net 60 unless both sides agree to extend the Net 45 arrangement.

I've also sent the signature packet via DocuSign for the vendor terms (link below). Attaching a sample invoice layout so AP has the fields they expect. Miguel (cc) is our CFO and will review the final PO language.

Attachments: orchid_sample-invoice-DEC2026.pdf
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-orchid-terms

Best,
Elena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@orchidcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment terms & invoice lane request

Elena — thanks for the sample invoice and DocuSign link. Internal note for finance ops:

- We can create a PO for Orchid Cloud with a special AP route labeled "Vendor-Accelerated (pilot)".
- Need confirmation of the exact early-pay percentage (Elena proposed 2.0% for first 90 days). Finance prefers a single agreed % stated on PO.
- Please provide bank details via the attached bank details form so we can set up ACH routing.

Markus — if we lock at Net 45 + 2.0% early-pay for 90 days, AP estimates PO issuance in ~7 business days after signed DocuSign and receipt of bank details.

Elena — attaching Redwood bank details form (orchid_bank_details_form.pdf) for you to complete.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@orchidcloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment terms & invoice lane request

Hi all — closing loop from procurement:

- Procurement approves a conditional onboarding exception: Net 45 with 1.5% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days, for a 90-day pilot window. After 90 days, account will default to Net 60 unless mutual agreement to continue Net 45.
- Rationale: It protects Redwood cashflow while providing Orchid a meaningful acceleration.
- AP and Finance will honor 2.0% only if a legal/finance sign-off is completed that accepts that higher concession; otherwise 1.5% is our standard accelerated concession.

Please confirm which concession Orchid accepts (1.5% or 2.0%), and upload the signed DocuSign and bank details form. Once both are in, Marissa will create the PO (7 business days).

Neha Kapoor
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Elena Rossi <elena@orchidcloud.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment terms & invoice lane request

Neha / Marissa / Markus — thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging the finance approval path. Orchid accepts the procurement concession: Net 45 with 1.5% early-pay if paid within 15 days for the first 90 days.

I've attached the signed DocuSign packet and our completed bank details form. Also attaching the invoice we'll submit for the first month. Please confirm when the PO is created and the AP lane is live so we can align invoice submission dates.

Attachments: orchid_signed_terms_docusign.pdf, orchid_bank_details_form.pdf, orchid_sample-invoice-DEC2026.pdf

Best regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of Revenue Operations | Orchid Cloud
elena@orchidcloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
